title: OneDrive and SharePoint: block screen capture of sensitivity-labelled PDFs in the web viewer
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap plan and distinguishes it from existing sensitivity-label controls. Both documented controls and their PowerShell calls are supported; minor corrections would complete the label-editing route and name an example qualifying licence.
